caption: A goldfish swims around a round bowl, and seen through the curved glass it appears to swell and shrink as it passes the curve.

sa.check: A goldfish swims around a bowl.
Seen through the glass it appears to swell and shrink as it passes the curve.
The bowl is round with curved glass.

pc.expect: The fish keeps its true size and shape; the swell and shrink are appearances through the curve.
pc.fail: The fish actually changes size; or changes shape; or splits.

pc.expect: The size change happens only through the curved glass and water.
pc.fail: The fish is unchanged through the curve; or changes seen from above the water; or the bowl is opaque.

pc.expect: The fish stays inside the water.
pc.fail: It passes through the glass; or swims out; or appears outside.

pc.expect: The bowl is rigid and the water level.
pc.fail: The bowl warps; or the water tilts and holds; or goes opaque.
A second fish appears; or the fish vanishes; or the bowl duplicates.

pc.expect: The fish's colour and the bowl stay the same.
pc.fail: The fish changes colour; or the bowl changes shape; or the table changes.

note: The fish is self-driven; only the view through the curve is judged.
